caption: The drawing features two primary objects: a decorative plate (shown in a top-down view on the left side) and a matching bowl (shown in a side view on the right side). The plate and bowl both have a recurring design motif composed of red-orange six-petal flowers with black dots and radiating lines, blue and yellow circular floral elements, peach-colored round fruits or flowers with three black lines, and large light green leaves. Additionally, there are curved lavender shapes and intricate black fern-like foliage interwoven among the flowers and leaves. Both the plate and bowl have a lavender outer rim. There is also a lightly sketched circle above the bowl, marked with the numbers "4" and "8v." The composition is rendered on a beige background, and the artist’s name "E. Schwebe" is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
